original_name: 淫乱OL 沢渡登喜子～女達の淫靡な素顔～
source:
Daisuke is a security guard of a building. One day, when he is patrolling around at night, he finds Tokiko masturbating on the desk. Tokiko says, "Please keep it secret. I'll do whatever you want...." Daisuke says, "If you want to keep it secret...." He tries to have sex with Tokiko, but she suddenly runs away.
